visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a black long-sleeved crop top and matching black pants, stands in the center of a modern white kitchen. She looks directly at the camera with a friendly expression, gesturing with her hands while speaking. The background features a minimalist kitchen with white countertops, integrated appliances, and a unique curved linear light fixture hanging from the ceiling. (2) The woman leans forward over a white kitchen island, pointing at specific spots on the surface. The camera zooms in to show a close-up of the countertop texture. She uses her hands to sweep across the surface, indicating the area she is discussing. (3) A split-screen montage shows a worker in a white polo shirt and a face mask applying a coating to the kitchen sink area. In another shot, a different worker is seen carefully wiping the countertop near the stove. The lighting remains bright and even throughout the process. (4) A series of 'Before' and 'After' shots compare the appearance of the black gas stove. The 'After' shots show a significantly higher gloss and cleaner finish. Yellow captions appear on the screen to label the differences. (5) A demonstration occurs where dark liquid (soy sauce) and red sauce (ketchup) are poured onto the white countertop. A hand wearing a black protective glove uses a yellow microfiber cloth to easily wipe the sauces away in a single motion, leaving no residue or staining. (6) The woman returns to the frame, lying flat across the polished countertop to show its smoothness. She is smiling broadly, her eyes sparkling with excitement. She runs her hands along the surface and eventually sits up to wave goodbye to the camera as the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with bright, upbeat acoustic guitar strumming at a moderate tempo. A cheerful female voice introduces the service provider, speaking with clear articulation and high emotional valence. There is a very faint room tone in the background. (2) A transition is marked by a subtle 'whoosh' sound effect. A male voice joins the conversation, sounding professional and friendly. He explains the cleaning benefits while the acoustic guitar continues steadily underneath. (3) Short percussive thuds and the sound of rustling are heard as workers clean the kitchen. The female speaker's pitch rises as she expresses surprise and delight at the results. A light 'ding' SFX highlights a visual change on screen. (4) The sounds of liquid being squeezed and poured onto a hard surface are audible, followed by the soft rhythmic friction of a cloth wiping the countertop. The BGM maintains a consistent, happy rhythm. (5) The female voice becomes more energetic and loud, exclaiming with high arousal. The music builds slightly in volume towards the end as she delivers a call to action for a giveaway, concluding with a final upbeat chord.
